correctness.rationale: Re-audited repairs/1/RESULT.md. At zero cyclic separation the Green recurrence yields c(r⁻¹−r)(1−r^n)=1 and off zero the characteristic relation gives zero. Independent, class-restricted Rademacher probes sum unbiasedly; pair coefficients give 4 Σ_same G_ij², or 2 Σ_d f_d(n+C_d). The telescoping relation f_d−f_m=2 Σ_(k>d)(k−d)a_k gives the exact window certificate, with each coefficient positive and each window difference nonnegative by parity. A one-defect reference fills the odd/even window lower bounds and has C_d=(−1)^d(n−2d). Any nonoptimal word has at least three defects, forcing T₂ to increase by at least eight. On flipping reference sites 2 and 3, only the windows ending at 2 or starting at 3 may change, with pair of sums (1,−1)→(−1,1) at odd k≥3 and (2,0)→(0,2) at even k≥4. Therefore the higher T_k are unchanged; the word is admissible and attains 16a₂, including m=2 where only the endpoint coefficient is defined. For the baseline comparison, same solve count means averaging two independent full-support probes; domination by a geometric series justifies the fixed-μ limit. An independent exact rational replay in branches/268a8060-5c50-42cb-afd7-111b79b45d79/gap_check.py and gap_check_output.txt confirmed 20 parameter cases (21,824 words modulo color exchange, including the inadmissible constant words in the scan); it uses weights f_d/c², direct pair enumeration and the admissible witness, not the window formula as an oracle. These finite tests are corroboration only; the analytic proof establishes all allowed n and μ. Uploaded code was not executed.
